description: 68010-visible address ranges already explained by frozen evidence, for masking memory snapshots down to unexplained residue. Byte extents are conservative: only bytes the evidence pins are 'explained'; anything width-unresolved is 'tracked', never silently masked.

regions.label: adsp-program-window
regions.note: ADSP program upload target; title-path coverage observed through 0x8048D6.

regions.label: adsp-control-window
regions.note: 11 control ops, 73 all-zero writes per 600-frame title run.

regions.label: adsp-irq-clear
regions.note: Two repeatable writes per title run from PCs 0x021426/0x02C234.

regions.label: gsp-fifo-submit
regions.note: GSP FIFO submit longword; one write per ADSP-buffer count unit.

regions.label: zram-view
regions.note: M48T02/EEPROM persistent view; contains the high-score table below.

regions.label: nvram-high-score-table
regions.note: Ten 24-byte records; kept as its own entry for decoder provenance.

regions.label: input-mirror
regions.note: Input-trace write range mirroring the IN0/IN1/DSW/event-scanner state.

regions.label: time-remaining
regions.note: u16 assumed from observed range 8540-7966; wider extent unresolved, so only these two bytes mask.

regions.label: object-hit-counter
regions.note: Counter width unresolved; only the observed bytes mask.

regions.label: object-records
regions.note: Known consumer traffic with unresolved ownership; reported separately, never silently masked.

regions.label: ram-structure-candidate
regions.note: Structure base with pointer writes; semantic ownership unresolved.
